verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine, so a unified place to manage models, prompts and per-model settings is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no such hub: no model library or download manager, no saved prompts, and no per-model configuration profiles. Adjacent items like Hugging Face model integration, CLI serve flags and per-scheme quantization backend overrides are related controls, not this capability, so they earn no credit.
